index_schema.authoritative_state: exposed_frequency rebuilt from every non-target nonzero cached vector term
index_schema.buckets: frequency-indexed Vec<Vec<Mono>>; every committed bucket is strictly natural-Mono sorted
index_schema.delta: one folded remove/add per touched row at commit; removal must be a subset and addition must not collide

entry.committed: checked u32 frequency or u32::MAX new-row sentinel

index_schema.map_index_guard: every new nonzero term asserts index count equals exposed_frequency count; every commit asserts bucket/entry census and strict dirty buckets; full map-count/order equality is a mandatory external gate
index_schema.rank_order: ascending numeric frequency, then natural Mono order
index_schema.restart: rebuild index from authoritative vector cache; never alter checkpoint or vector-cache schemas

required_guard_markers: rare-order removal delta is not a bucket subset
rare-order addition collides with retained row
v4 rare-order index requires fixed cold/rare/16 hierarchical nonincremental mode
scope: Static source/interface audit only; no solve or continuation.

source_review.commit: folded dirty rows; sorted removal/addition deltas; strict merge/census
source_review.initial_index: rebuilt after complete vector restore/frequency scan
source_review.lookup: 16 FNV shards are lookup-only; frozen rank enumeration precedes sharding
source_review.mode_guard: all modes except fixed cold/rare/16 hierarchical nonincremental fail closed
source_review.process_persistence: one mutable index lives across the sparse loop
source_review.rank: ascending frequency buckets and natural Mono bodies; census guarded in-process
source_review.rank_hash: removed from hot path; full map/order equality is mandatory in an external read-only gate
source_review.update: map checked increment then index checked bump with per-hit equality
